title: Clinical Testing of New MR Pulse Sequences
brief_summary: To test and validate newly developed magnetic resonance (MR) pulse sequences for their ability to enhance the collection of morphological, biomedical, and functional information from the human body. To test clinical protocols on the various MR systems available at Brigham and Women's Hospital (BWH).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy volunteers
* Patients undergoing clinical indicated MRI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with contraindication for MRI
* Pregnant women will be excluded from this study
condition: The Focus of This Study Are New Pulse Sequences.
